| **Likelihood** | probable — AI-skill hiring is already concentrated in a few dozen US metros and gains are pooling in leading firms. |
| **Assessed** | 2026-11-27 |

Aggregate job losses are modest, but the firms, roles and metro areas best placed to use AI capture the productivity gains. Regional gaps widen and an 'AI underclass' of excluded workers, firms and communities forms.
